g.text: 100_2_3_1 | one mature receiver pass | all paired effects
Positive values favour A. Points: all three paired source seeds; black marks: medians. No confidence intervals.
R: original live donors; G/S: add paid global/shared donors; UNION: ordinary combined pool. Not a full-algorithm trial.
